correctness.rationale: The frozen RESULT.md quotient dynamics and potential were independently checked: phi=(-x-y,2x-y,2y-x) yields phi_dot_i=-3K(sin phi_i-mean sin phi) and V_dot=-3K sum(sin phi_i-mean)^2. Equal-sine zero-sum triples give exactly three uniform triples plus the three permutations of (0,pi,pi); det[[2,-1],[-1,2]]=3 lifts each, yielding 18 equilibria. Independently verified Jacobian eigenvalues (-3K,-3K), (3K/2,3K/2), (-K,3K), giving 3 sinks, 6 sources, 9 saddles and potential levels 0,9/2,4. Strict decrease excludes cycles and same-level saddle connections, finite omega-limits converge, stable/unstable intersections with sources/sinks are transverse; threefold phase translation permutes sinks and preserves flat measure, giving 4*pi^2/3 per basin. These are global analytic deductions, not consequences of the 24 sample trajectories.
